response.overview: Super Bowl LVI, played on February 13, 2022, at SoFi Stadium in Inglewood, California, saw the Los Angeles Rams defeat the Cincinnati Bengals 23-20, earning their second Super Bowl title in franchise history and their first representing Los Angeles. The game was marked by a dramatic fourth-quarter comeback, a ferocious defensive performance, and a storybook finish for several Rams veterans.
response.tagline: Los Angeles Rams vs. Cincinnati Bengals
response.title: Super Bowl LVI
